subject: Tidal demo window proposal + next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tidal demo window proposal + follow-up from today's call

Alex — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive/demo with your eng leads.

Call recap (2 min):
- Primary use case: Medicore wants a predictable inference path for LLM-backed triage and discharge summaries (low-latency at scale).
- Success metrics: p99 latency < 200ms for 512-token requests; cost target ~$0.008/token (net).
- Security: SOC2 + VPC requirement; will need SOC2 evidence and network diagram (we've attached the standard pack).

Next step: technical deep dive (90 min) — recommended attendees: Alex, Jason Park (engineering), your infra lead, + Redwood TPM + runtime engineer.

Scheduling constraints you mentioned: distributed team across US/EU/APAC and a desire to rotate meeting windows so no single region always takes nights. To make scheduling low-friction I sketched a rotating-cadence proposal below. Please pick the option that works or send alternate times.

Proposal (rotating "tidal" windows):
- Option A (Americas-first week): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (good for US product & east-coast eng)
- Option B (EMEA-first week): Wed 15:00 CEST (14:00 BST) — aligns with EMEA daytime
- Option C (APAC-first week): Thu 09:30 SGT / 11:30 JST — friendly for APAC eng in Singapore/Tokyo

Cadence suggestion: run the deep dive every other week with a 3-week rotation: Week1=A, Week2=B, Week3=C; repeats. That gives each region a daytime slot once every three sessions. If a single deep dive is preferred, propose the best single slot and we'll schedule it.

To expedite: 1) pick A/B/C or 2) paste two preferred windows next 2 weeks and I'll send invites.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MAP), redwood-demo-deck.pdf (light deck).
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/tidal-demo-window?month=2028-07

Thanks — I can coordinate invites after you confirm.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: [mutual_action_plan.xlsx (12KB, spreadsheet)], [redwood-demo-deck.pdf (2.3MB, presentation)]

Subject: Re: Tidal demo window proposal + follow-up from today's call

Grace — thanks for the clear recap and the rotation idea. I like the fairness of the 3-week cadence. A couple notes from my side:

- Our infra lead (Jason) is in London and would prefer the EMEA slot, but we also have senior analysts in Singapore who would need APAC-friendly times every so often.
- If we commit to a rotating schedule, could we also include a short 30-min "handoff" overlap in the following week for the region coming online (so documentation handoff & Qs)? Not necessary every time, but helpful during the first 2 cycles.

Availability (next two weeks):
- Week of Jul 25: Wed 15:00–17:00 CEST (best for Jason) or Tue 10:00–12:00 PT (I can make one of these)
- Week of Aug 1: Thu 09:00–11:00 SGT (API team in SG prefers mornings)

If EMEA-first (Option B) this week, Wed Jul 26 15:00 CEST works for us. If you can lock a 90-min slot then include a optional 30-min "handoff" on Fri morning SGT (we'll mark optional).

Also please upload the SOC2 evidence to a shared link (we can't accept attachments over 10MB in our procurement tracker).

—Alex Turner
